entities.summary:
Francis Perrin was a French physicist,
who worked on nuclear physics, fission and neutrinos. He was the high-commissioner Commissariat à l'énergie atomique in France and a collaborator of CERN. He was involved in the development of nuclear weapons for France and the cooperation with Israel on nuclear research.
